title: Multilingual Medical RAG Assistant for Lecture-Based Learning
one_liner: Transform multilingual medical PDFs and PowerPoint lectures into a searchable, citation-backed AI assistant with image-aware references and exam practice generation.
problem: Medical students and professionals often work with large lecture collections containing mixed formats, slide images, scanned content, and multilingual text in English, French, and German. Finding accurate answers, tracing them back to the original lecture material, and preparing exam-style questions manually is time-consuming and difficult.
approach: Built a RAG-based knowledge system from medical lecture PDFs and PowerPoint files containing multilingual text, diagrams, and slide images
Extracted and indexed lecture content with page-level and slide-level references so answers could be traced back to the original source material
Integrated image-aware referencing to help users connect generated answers with relevant diagrams, figures, and visual lecture content
Used ChromaDB as the vector database for semantic retrieval across medical learning materials
Integrated Gemini models for question answering, reasoning over retrieved context, and multilingual response generation
Created a dashboard where users can switch between local lecture-material search and internet-based source mode
Added MCQ generation for exam preparation with Fast, Balanced, and Deep modes depending on the user’s desired speed and depth
results: Created a structured medical knowledge assistant that makes large lecture collections easier to search, study, and review
Enabled citation-backed answers with PDF page numbers and PowerPoint slide references for improved trust and traceability
Supported multilingual learning across English, French, and German lecture content
Improved exam preparation by generating customizable MCQs directly from the uploaded medical study material
Delivered an interactive dashboard suitable for students, educators, and medical training workflows

title: Document AI for Structured Field Extraction
one_liner: Extract business-critical fields from PDFs and scans, then convert them into structured outputs ready for automation.
problem: Organizations often handle documents with inconsistent templates, which makes manual extraction expensive and rule-only systems difficult to maintain.
approach: Combined OCR, layout parsing, and field-detection logic into a reusable extraction pipeline
Applied rule-based and ML/NLP methods where each was most effective
Produced validated JSON/CSV outputs designed for APIs, analytics, and internal tools
results: Flexible document extraction workflow across multiple template variants
Reduced friction when integrating document data into downstream products

title: Video RAG for Searchable Long-Form Content
one_liner: Make long videos searchable by turning transcripts and segments into a retrieval-powered Q&A experience.
problem: Finding specific information in lectures, meetings, or long recordings is time-consuming when users must scrub through the full video manually.
approach: Extracted transcripts and organized video content into semantically meaningful segments
Indexed segment-level text with embeddings to support accurate retrieval
Generated answers from the most relevant retrieved moments instead of the full recording
results: Searchable video knowledge base for long-form content
Faster access to relevant moments and answers inside recordings

title: Data-Grounded LLM Writing Assistant with Review UI
one_liner: Generate domain-specific content from connected knowledge sources through a controllable, review-friendly LLM interface.
problem: Business users need AI-generated text that reflects their own data, follows constraints, and remains easy to review before publishing or sharing.
approach: Grounded generation with retrieval from custom knowledge sources and structured context
Added templates, tone controls, and guardrails to shape the generated output
Built a user interface for drafting, reviewing, and exporting content
results: More consistent, context-aware text generation for real workflows
Accessible content-generation experience for non-technical users

title: Character Consistency with LoRA + Stable Diffusion
one_liner: Train a LoRA-based image generation workflow that preserves a character’s identity across prompts, poses, and scenes.
problem: Creative teams often need the same character to appear consistently across multiple images, but default image generation can drift in facial features, clothing, and styling.
approach: Prepared a focused character dataset for Stable Diffusion adaptation
Fine-tuned a LoRA workflow to improve identity retention and visual repeatability
Refined prompts and sampling settings to support consistency across different scene concepts
results: More stable recurring-character generation for storytelling and branded visuals
Reusable workflow for character-focused creative production

title: CV–Job Description Matching with Semantic Ranking
one_liner: Match CVs to job descriptions with semantic similarity, ranking features, and explainable skill-gap insights.
problem: Recruiters and applicants need a faster way to evaluate role fit than manual keyword matching, especially when equivalent skills are phrased differently.
approach: Extracted role-relevant terms, skills, and text signals with NLP pipelines
Computed semantic alignment using transformer embeddings and similarity methods
Added scoring logic and missing-skill feedback to make results more actionable
results: More informative CV–JD matching than keyword overlap alone
Actionable fit summaries that support screening and candidate improvement

title: Address Extraction Review Tool for Scanned Documents
one_liner: Extract address fields from scanned documents and route them through a review UI before export.
problem: Address blocks can be fragmented, noisy, or inconsistently formatted in real documents, creating errors in billing, shipping, and back-office workflows.
approach: Located candidate address regions using OCR and layout-aware heuristics
Structured components with NER- and rule-based parsing logic
Added a correction interface so users can review and fix uncertain outputs before export
results: Practical extraction flow for messy address data in scanned documents
Human-in-the-loop review path for safer operational use

title: ML Prediction Dashboard with API Serving
one_liner: Serve machine-learning predictions through APIs and make model outputs easier to interpret in an interactive dashboard.
problem: Stakeholders often need prediction systems that are not only accurate, but also accessible, comparable, and easy to review.
approach: Trained and compared multiple machine-learning model families for prediction tasks
Built REST API endpoints for online and batch inference workflows
Created dashboard views for outputs, metrics, and model-facing interaction
results: End-to-end path from model prediction to business-facing visualization
Reusable pattern for production-style ML demo applications

title: Financial Data Assistant with PostgreSQL + GPT
one_liner: Let users query structured financial data in natural language and receive clear, application-ready responses.
problem: Business users often need insights from market data without writing SQL or manually translating questions into database operations.
approach: Stored market data in PostgreSQL and organized it for structured querying
Combined retrieval and LLM reasoning to interpret user questions where useful
Returned formatted responses designed for dashboards, APIs, and decision-support interfaces
results: Natural-language access layer for structured financial datasets
Reusable pattern for database-backed AI assistants

title: AI Workflow Automation with n8n, APIs & LLMs
one_liner: Design AI-powered business automations in n8n that connect triggers, APIs, databases, and LLM-based processing.
problem: Clients need repeatable workflows for lead handling, content processing, notifications, and data enrichment without constantly building custom glue code.
approach: Built trigger-driven flows that ingest, process, store, and notify across connected systems
Integrated LLMs, APIs, webhooks, and databases into reusable automations
Added retries, logging, and failure-aware handling to make workflows easier to operate
results: Reduced repetitive manual work in AI-assisted business processes
Client-friendly automation patterns that can be adapted across use cases

title: Surfing Pose Tracking & Maneuver Recognition
one_liner: Analyze surfing videos with robust pose tracking and temporal maneuver recognition for coaching-style feedback.
problem: Surf footage is difficult to analyze because of water spray, camera motion, occlusions, and fast athlete movement, yet coaches still need reliable feedback signals.
approach: Implemented multiple pose-estimation backends to improve keypoint tracking under difficult footage
Smoothed temporal trajectories and engineered motion features from joint geometry and movement cues
Built a sequence-modeling pipeline for maneuver recognition and real-time feedback delivery
results: More stable pose-based analysis in challenging sports video
Product-oriented foundation for maneuver detection and coaching feedback

title: 3D Dental Scan Alignment with Point Clouds
one_liner: Align dental 3D scans through point-cloud registration and coarse-to-fine geometry matching.
problem: Dental analysis workflows depend on precise 3D alignment, but noisy scans and imperfect geometry can make registration unreliable.
approach: Prepared mesh and point-cloud inputs from common 3D and medical formats
Applied coarse-to-fine registration using RANSAC/FGR/ICP-style techniques
Focused on stability across imperfect scans and varied alignment conditions
results: Reusable 3D registration workflow for dental geometry tasks
More dependable preprocessing for downstream visualization and analysis

title: Real-Time YOLO Object Detection Pipeline
one_liner: Develop real-time object detection pipelines with YOLOv8 and deployment-ready inference optimization.
problem: Video applications need object detection that remains accurate while meeting latency and deployment constraints.
approach: Trained YOLOv8 detection models with augmentation and iterative evaluation
Optimized inference using ONNX, TensorRT, and CUDA-oriented deployment paths
Served predictions through API-based workflows and containerized packaging
results: Production-oriented object detection setup for real-time use cases
Deployment-friendly model artifacts and serving pattern

title: YOLO Segmentation for Visual Inspection
one_liner: Build segmentation systems for visual inspection and measurement tasks using YOLO-based models.
problem: Many industrial and inspection problems require pixel-level understanding rather than simple bounding-box detection.
approach: Trained a YOLO segmentation workflow with augmentation and dataset quality improvements
Evaluated segmentation behavior with task-relevant metrics such as IoU, precision, and recall
Prepared optimized inference exports for practical deployment scenarios
results: Segmentation pipeline suited to inspection-style computer vision workflows
Optimized path from training to inference deployment

title: Diffusion-Guided 3D Asset Generation
one_liner: Explore diffusion-guided generation of textured 3D assets through modern image and 3D modeling techniques.
problem: Creating detailed 3D assets is slow and specialized, while text- or image-guided generation can accelerate ideation and prototyping.
approach: Used diffusion-based guidance methods such as ControlNet and LoRA for detail generation
Explored 3D representations and reconstruction approaches including NeRF-style and splatting-inspired workflows
Connected experimental components into prototype interfaces for testing end-to-end generation ideas
results: Research-oriented pipeline for faster 3D asset ideation
Reusable experimental foundation for generative 3D workflows

title: Diabetic Retinopathy Screening with Transfer Learning
one_liner: Classify retinal fundus images with CNNs and transfer learning to support diabetic retinopathy screening workflows.
problem: Retinal image review is time-intensive, and real-world images vary in quality, contrast, and disease visibility.
approach: Applied preprocessing, contrast enhancement, and augmentation to improve input robustness
Built CNN and transfer-learning models with fine-tuning across established architectures
Used class-balancing and threshold-aware evaluation to support screening-oriented classification
results: Well-structured medical imaging classification pipeline
Stronger robustness for low-quality or visually challenging retinal samples
